verdict.rationale: Financial statement reporting is a fair axis for accounting software like FreeAgent, but the evidence pack never mentions a profit and loss report, a balance sheet, or a cash-flow statement for chosen periods. The only related item is a real-time cashflow dashboard with a 90-day projection. That is an adjacent forecasting feature, not on-demand period financial statements, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate an accurate P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any period on demand
